name: Consensus-Anchored Policy Distillation
research_target: one deployable policy that combines EGTR upside with UTR-centered cross-seed reliability

mathematical_skeleton.egtr_centroid: normalized geometric mean of three explorer categorical policies
mathematical_skeleton.disagreement: mean Jensen-Shannon divergence from the EGTR centroid
mathematical_skeleton.continuous_confidence: exp(-disagreement/tau), with tau positive and frozen before any student training
mathematical_skeleton.target: normalized geometric interpolation from UTR anchor to EGTR centroid using continuous confidence
mathematical_skeleton.student_actor_objective: ordinary fixed-stratified PPO plus bounded KL(teacher_target || student_policy)

information_boundary.student_state_source: future separately frozen fixed-stratified training-only rollouts
